source_text: Format 2: is the LANGUAGE of the ll-10 grammar LL, even though that grammar itself (E -> E + T | T, T -> i) is left-recursive and therefore not LL(k) for any k? [trap: grammar != language] The same left-recursive grammar as ll-10 is given here on purpose -- eliminating left recursion gives E -> T E', E' -> + T E' | eps, which IS LL(1), so the language is LL(1) even though this particular grammar is not.
question: is_ll_language
